question: How large is the Agave angustifolia chloroplast genome, and how many annotated genes does it hold?
expect: 157,274 bp; 132 genes (86 protein-coding, 38 tRNAs, 8 rRNAs) (Fig. 6 caption, p9)
rendered: According to the document, the Agave angustifolia chloroplast genome (plastome) is 157,274 base pairs (bp) in size. It contains 132 annotated genes, including 86 protein-coding genes, 38 transfer RNAs (tRNAs), and 8 ribosomal RNAs (rRNAs).
